_reference.english: Cleanse all Allies. Dispel and Stun Daemon and Undead Enemies. Gain an extra turn.

sourceEvidence.note: troop:6518 Sister Superior SpellId 7710, cost 6, Green/Yellow; "Cleanse all Allies. Dispel and Stun Daemon and Undead Enemies. Gain an extra turn."

target-count-range.note: All allies cleansed; only Daemon / Undead enemies dispelled and stunned (a Daemon+Undead troop once).

base-formula-rounding.note: No numeric formula in this spell.

conditions-probabilities-branches.note: Race filter Daemon OR Undead; no such enemy -> only cleanse + extra turn.

status-duration-immunity.note: Cleanse keeps Barrier (R002); Dispel removes Barrier/Enchanted/Reflect/Blessed etc. before Stun (a Blessed Daemon is stunned); R004 durations.

order-death-retargeting.note: Cleanse -> Dispel -> Stun -> ExtraTurn matches native (daemon/undead split steps equivalent to one filtered segment).

mana-economy-extra-turn.note: Unconditional skill extra turn; a Frozen caster is cleansed at step 0 and therefore still gains it (native order).

battle-pipeline.note: Real TurnEngine.castSkill both sides: skill-cast first, mana spent, one action-log entry, turn switch / extra-turn asserted; low-mana and Silence refusals leave board/log/turn untouched.
